note: CPU-first expression compiler. Each expression is sampled into real Concat setClipKey commands; no JS engine, no GPU. Params are the public knobs; the compiler samples deterministically.

expressions.name: Wiggle
expressions.description: Smooth pseudo-random oscillation. Seeded, so it is reproducible.

expressions.name: Sine Wave
expressions.description: Pure sine motion for loops, pulses and oscillation.

expressions.name: Damped Sine
expressions.description: Bounce that settles - spring, recoil, elastic ease.

expressions.name: Pulse
expressions.description: Duty-cycle pulse between two values - strobes and blinks.

expressions.name: Random Steps
expressions.description: Seeded random values held between steps - glitch and vernacular motion.

expressions.name: Drift
expressions.description: Linear ramp from start to start+slope*time.

expressions.name: Loop Out
expressions.description: Repeat a source span; pingpong alternates direction.

expressions.name: Follow Path
expressions.description: Move along control points; compiles to offsetX + offsetY keyframes.
